usdc.label: USDC
usdc.text: A digital dollar on Solana. Bids and payments are in USDC, a stablecoin tied to the US dollar.

devnet.label: Devnet
devnet.text: A separate Solana network used for trials. Your wallet must be switched to it.

wallet.label: Wallet
wallet.text: Your Solana wallet, such as Phantom. It holds your USDC and your cards. We never see its secret key.

signature.label: Signature
signature.text: Your confirmation in the wallet. It proves the wallet is yours and approves one action. Your secret key stays secret.

paddle.label: Bidding number
paddle.text: Your number in the room. It lets you bid up to your limit without a wallet window for every bid. Also called a paddle.

bid.label: Binding bid
bid.text: A bid is a promise you confirm. It is binding: if you hold the highest bid when the lot closes, payment is due.

reserve.label: Minimum price
reserve.text: The lowest price at which the seller will sell. If the top bid stays below it, the lot is not sold. Also called the reserve.

hammer.label: Sold
hammer.text: A lot is sold when its clock runs out and the top bid reaches the minimum price. The server clock decides, not a person.

hammerPrice.label: Sale price
hammerPrice.text: The price a lot sold for: the top bid when its clock ran out. Also called the hammer price.

antiSniping.label: Anti-sniping
antiSniping.text: A bid in the last seconds extends the clock a little, up to a limit, so nobody wins by bidding at the very last moment.

networkFee.label: Network fee
networkFee.text: The small fee the Solana network charges for every transaction. Hammerprice pays it.

onChain.label: On-chain
onChain.text: Recorded publicly on the Solana blockchain, where anyone can check it and nobody can quietly change it.

transaction.label: Transaction
transaction.text: A bundle of steps the network runs all together or not at all.

settlement.label: Payment and handover
settlement.text: The last step of a sale, when the money and the card change hands. Also called settlement.

memo.label: Memo
memo.text: A short note attached to a payment on the blockchain. Ours holds a fingerprint of the bids, so anyone can recheck the sale.

verify.label: Verify
verify.text: To check something yourself. Verifying your wallet is a free confirmation. The audit page rechecks the bids of a sale.

ecvrf.label: ECVRF
ecvrf.text: A random draw that comes with a public proof, so anyone can check that the result was not picked by hand.

testUsdc.label: Test USDC
testUsdc.text: Free USDC for trying the site out. You can claim it in the room.

replica.label: Replica
replica.text: A card that is marked as a replica in the demo rooms. It stands in for the original.
